{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of loyal customers who converted
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Output the result
conversion_rate"}
